# KYU? Streetwear

> Premium oversized streetwear designed in India. Heavyweight 240 GSM cotton t-shirts featuring minimal fronts and bold back graphic designs.

## Brand & Foundation

- Brand Name: KYU? (KYU? Streetwear)
- Category: Indian Streetwear
- Founded: 2026
- Founders: Jisha Salariya and Tanisha Joshi
- Headquarters: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Brand Manifesto: Built around the philosophy of inquiry and curiosity ("KYU?" / क्यों?), the label creates heavyweight, oversized apparel with a focus on premium material quality, durable construction, and storytelling graphics. Season One focuses on 240 GSM drop-shoulder boxy fit t-shirts.

## Products (Season One)

- Vintage Torque Tee: https://kyuwear.vercel.app/product/vintage-torque-tee
  - Description: A nod to raw horsepower and street heritage. 240 GSM heavyweight cotton, drop-shoulder oversized fit. ₹699.
- Spill the Tea: https://kyuwear.vercel.app/product/spill-the-tea
  - Description: Features artistic Hindi typography with earthy aesthetic detailing. 240 GSM heavyweight cotton, drop-shoulder oversized fit. ₹699.
- Karikala Chola: https://kyuwear.vercel.app/product/karikala-chola
  - Description: Built on legacy, designed for dominance. A tribute to the Chola empire where heritage meets bold streetwear. 240 GSM heavyweight cotton, drop-shoulder oversized fit. ₹699.

## Specifications & Materials

- Fabric: 240 GSM Terry Cotton
- Weight: 240 GSM (Grams per Square Meter) Heavyweight Quality
- Fit: Oversized, relaxed drop-shoulder boxy fit
- Available Sizes: S, M, L, XL
- Origin: Indore, India
